title: FlashSaleHoldRequest
description: Published by Booking Service when flash sale mode is active (GET flash-sale:mode:{eventId} = 'active' from Redis). Consumed by Seat Inventory Service consumer group seat-inventory-service-consumer. All-or-nothing semantics: the Lua script holds ALL seatIds or NONE (ADR-006 §3.2, ADR-007 §3.5). Partition key: eventId — FIFO fairness per event.

messageId.description: Consumer deduplication key (NFR-REL-002). Seat Inventory checks Redis flash-hold-processed:{bookingId} before executing Lua — if present, return cached result without re-executing (ADR-006 §3.10).

bookingId.description: Value stored in Redis hold key: seat:{eventId}:{seatId} = bookingId. All-or-nothing: Lua sets this for ALL seatIds or none (ADR-006 §3.8).

customerId.description: Partition key for flash-sale.hold-results topic (avoids hotspot on popular events). Used by Notification Service to route WebSocket events.

eventId.description: Partition key for this topic. All requests for one event are serialised on one Kafka partition — source of FIFO fairness guarantee (ADR-007 §3.3).

seatIds.description: Seats to hold atomically. Booking Service validated 1-8 constraint before publishing. Consumer does NOT re-validate count.

idempotencyKey.description: Client idempotency key from POST /bookings (NFR-REL-001). Propagated through the flash sale queue for end-to-end idempotency.

expiresAt.description: UTC expiry = publishedAt + 600s. Consumer MUST check: if now() >= expiresAt, publish HOLD_EXPIRED without executing Lua (ADR-007 §3.5). Prevents holding seats for customers whose checkout sessions have already timed out.

publishedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the Booking Service published this message.

correlationId.description: Same as x-correlation-id header. Duplicated in payload to survive header-stripping middleware.
